headline: Approved FY27 tax rate of .7846, with residential at 15.3 and commercial at 33.96, plus a $3,000,000.00 free cash transfer.
summary: Councilor Santaniello said residents will pay $185 more this year. The assessor could not give an exact figure for commercial properties, which will also see an increase. Councilors approved the tax rate, a stabilization transfer, and a $3,000,000.00 free cash transfer.
decisions: Approved the stabilization transfer for the tax levy from Treasury bills interest, 12-0.
Approved transferring $3,000,000.00 of FY26 certified free cash to FY27 estimated revenues, 12-0.
Approved setting the FY27 tax rate at .7846, with residential at 15.3 and commercial at 33.96, 9-2 with one abstention.

plain_text:
City Council  
     
Regular Meeting 
 
~Final~ 
   
 
36 Court Street  
Springfield, MA 01103   
http://www.springfieldcityhall.com 
 
Gladys Oyola-Lopez 
 
November 24, 
2026 
5:30 PM City Hall - Room 200 
 
 
 
Roll Call 
COUNCILORS SANTANIELLO, WALSH, DELGADO, MARTIN, AND HURST WERE 
REMOTE FOR THIS MEETING.  COUNCILOR BROWN WAS ABSENT. 
Moment Of Silence - Pledge Of Allegiance 
 
Reports Of Committee 
COUNCILOR GOVAN THANKED THE COMMITTEE FOR THE WORK THAT WAS 
DONE LEADING UP TO THIS MEETING.  SHE PROVIDED SOME BACKGROUND AND 
EXAMPLES HOW RESIDENTS CONTINUE TO STRUGGLE WITH HIGH PROPERTY 
TAXES.  THIS PROCESS HAS GIVEN HER A BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF THE 
PROCESS THE CITY GOES THROUGH TO GET TO THIS POINT. 
COUNCIL PRESIDENT THANKED EVERYONE FOR THEIR WORK AS WELL. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO STATED THAT RESIDENTS WILL HAVE TO PAY $185 
MORE THIS YEAR, BUT WANTED THE FIGURE FOR BUSINESSES.  THE ASSESSOR 
COULD NOT PROVIDE AN EXACT FIGURE DUE TO THE DIFFERENT SIZES OF 
COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES, BUT THERE WILL BE AN INCREASE. 
COUNCILOR WALSH ALSO THANKED THE TEAM FOR THEIR EFFORTS. 
COUNCILOR PEREZ EDUCATED HERSELF ON FINANCIALS TO BETTER 
UNDERSTAND THE PROCESS TO FURTHER HELP HER CONSTITUENTS.  WE HAVE 
TO ADVOCATE MORE FOR THE YOUNGER RESIDENTS. 
 
Orders 
 1. Stabilization Transfer for Tax Levy — Treasury Bills Interest (Mayor Sarno) 
CAFO CATHY BUONO SPOKE ON THE TRANSFER. 
COUNCILOR SANTANIELLO WANTED TO VERIFY THAT THESE MONIES DO NOT 
COME OUT OF THE RETIREMENT ACCOUNT.
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown 
 2. Transfer — FY26 Certified Free Cash to FY27 Estimated Revenues — 
$3,000,000.00 (Mayor Sarno) 
CAFO CATHY BUONO SPOKE ON THE TRANSFER TO HELP OFFSET THE TAX RATE. 
 
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Justin Hurst, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Jose Delgado, 
Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin Edwards, Tracye Whitfield 
NAYS None 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN None 
ABSENT Malo Brown 
 
 
 3. Tax Factor – FY27 .7846 
COUNCILOR GOVAN MADE A MOTION TO SET THE TAX RATE AT .7846. 
 RESIDENTIAL - 15.3 AND COMMERCIAL - 33.96 
COUNCILOR DAVILA THANKED EVERYONE FOR THEIR WORK, BUT SATED THAT 
THERE ARE TRYING TIMES AHEAD.  THERE NEEDS TO BE MORE GROWTH TO 
OFFSET.  HE MENTIONED THE MIDDLE CLASS AND THE RESIDENTS THAT DO NOT 
QUALIFY FOR TARGETED TAX RELIEF.  
COUNCILOR FENTON THANKED THE COMMITTEE.  DOES NOT WANT THE PUBLIC 
TO LOSE SIGHT THAT THE CITY DOES VERY WELL OF ANYWHERE ACROSS THE 
STATE.  SPRINGFIELD IS AN ATTRACTIVE SPOT FOR HOMEOWNERS.  HE SIGHTED 
SPECIFIC EXAMPLES THOUGHT THE COMMONWEALTH.
AYES Brian Santaniello, Gerry Martin, Maria Perez, Zaida Govan, Kateri 
Walsh, Victor Davila, Michael Fenton, Lavar Click-Bruce, Melvin 
Edwards 
NAYS Justin Hurst, Tracye Whitfield 
AWAY None 
RECUSE None 
ABSTAIN Jose Delgado 
ABSENT Malo Brown
